title: Surpanakha allures Ravana to marry Seetha
introduction: Ravana enquires about Rama's valour and weaponry for which Shuurpanakha narrates about Rama, Seetha, and Lakshmana and what has happened in Janasthaana. Thus she prompts Ravana to achieve Seetha as his wife, for none surpasses Seetha in her beauty.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे चतुर् त्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 34th chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततः शूर्पणखाम् दृष्ट्वा ब्रुवन्तीम् परुषम् वचः |
अमात्य मध्ये संकृउद्धः परिपप्रच्छ रावणः
verses.iast:
tataḥ śūrpaṇakhām dṛṣṭvā bruvantīm paruṣam vacaḥ |
amātya madhye saṅkṛuddhaḥ paripapraccha rāvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: On observing Shuurpanakha who is speaking bitter words against him in the presence of ministers then Ravana is highly infuriated and queried her.

glosses.meaning: bitter, words, one who is speaking
highly, infuriated one, Ravana, questioned - queried.

verses.devanagari:
कः च रामः कथम् वीर्यः किम् रूपः किम् पराक्रमः |
किम् अर्थम् दण्डकारण्यम् प्रविष्टः च सुदुस्तरम्
verses.iast:
kaḥ ca rāmaḥ katham vīryaḥ kim rūpaḥ kim parākramaḥ |
kim artham daṇḍakāraṇyam praviṣṭaḥ ca sudustaram
verses.translation: "Who is Rama? How brave he is? Of what mien and what calibre he is? And for what reason he entered the highly inscrutable Dandaka forest?
notes: 'Why this Rama has to come this far to Dandaka instead of loitering somewhere near Himalayas? Has he come purposefully with any revenge against us, the demons, or is it a pleasure-trip? Why should he leave his ancestral kingdom and enter Dandaka, a stronghold of demons?' This is the real worry of Ravana. kena ca kāraṇena kula parampara āgatam prājyam rājyam parityajya nikhila niśācara vāso asmin deśe samāgataḥ - dk Ravana might be unaware that Dandaka forest also belongs to Ikshvaku-s as Kishkindha belonged to them, as said by Rama at the time of eliminating of Vali.

verses.devanagari:
आयुधम् किम् च रामस्य येन ते राक्षसाः हता |
खरः च निहतः संख्ये दूषणः त्रिशिराः तथा
तत् त्वम् ब्रूहि मनोज्ञान्गी केन त्वम् च विरूपिता |
verses.iast:
āyudham kim ca rāmasya yena te rākṣasāḥ hatā |
kharaḥ ca nihataḥ saṃkhye dūṣaṇaḥ triśirāḥ tathā
tat tvam brūhi manojñāngī kena tvam ca virūpitā |
verses.translation: "What is the weapon of that Rama by whom these many demons are killed in war, likewise Duushana and Trishira are killed, and even the unkillable Khara is killed? Oh, lady with fascinating limbs, who disfigured you? That you tell.
notes: This can be simple question 'What is his weapon?' without telling round about as above. But Ravana is weighing arsenal balance since he is self-content with a giant-robot namely Kumbhakarna, and with a brave and all-trickster son Indrajit, along with his own ICBMs, ASMs and ASMs, plus his own invincibility. Thereby he is said to be puzzled at arsenal-less Rama and asking: kāni kāni ca āyudhāni khara mukha niśācra prāṇa hāni karāṇi - dk'you said that Rama caused this havoc single-handedly, then he should have used various and numerous weapons by which missiles are flung... because common sense does not permit any belief that a handheld bow can dart numerous arrows or missile, that too when wielded by a single human...'

glosses.meaning: fascinating, having limbs - oh, lady with fascinating limbs [Shuurpanakha]
by whom, you are, disfigured, even

verses.devanagari:
इति उक्ता राक्षस इन्द्रेण राक्षसी क्रोध मूर्च्छिता
ततो रामम् यथा न्यायम् आख्यातुम् उपचक्रमे |
verses.iast:
iti uktā rākṣasa indreṇa rākṣasī krodha mūrcchitā
tato rāmam yathā nyāyam ākhyātum upacakrame |
verses.translation: When the king of demons has asked her thus, she that demoness Shuurpanakha who is in a fit of fury then commenced to describe Rama in the point of fact.

glosses.meaning: this way, she is who is spoken
with fury, who is in a fit of, demoness
as it is - in the point of fact

verses.devanagari:
दीर्घबाहुः विशालाक्षः चीर कृष्ण अजिन अम्बरः
कन्दर्प सम रूपः च रामो दशरथ आत्मजः |
verses.iast:
dīrghabāhuḥ viśālākṣaḥ cīra kṛṣṇa ajina ambaraḥ
kandarpa sama rūpaḥ ca rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ |
verses.translation: "Dasharatha's son Rama is the one with inescapable arms and keen-eyed, but has jute-cloths and skin of black-deer for his dress, yet in semblance he is similar to the Love-god.

glosses.meaning: long, one with arms, or implicitly- inescapable arms
broad, eyed one, or implicitly - keen eyed
black, deer, skin, as his dress

verses.devanagari:
शक्र चाप निभम् चापम् विकृष्य कनकांगदम्
दीप्तान् क्षिपति नाराचान् सर्पान् इव महा विषान् |
verses.iast:
śakra cāpa nibham cāpam vikṛṣya kanakāṃgadam
dīptān kṣipati nārācān sarpān iva mahā viṣān |
verses.translation: "Yanking out a bow with golden fillets, and that is similar to the bow of Indra in its shine, he strews candent iron-arrows that simulate snakes with deadly poison.

glosses.meaning: that has golden, fillets, a bow
those that have deadly, poison, snakes, like

verses.devanagari:
न आददानम् शरान् घोरान् न मुंचंतम् महाबलम्
न कार्मुकम् विकर्षन्तम् रामम् पश्यामि संयुगे |
verses.iast:
na ādadānam śarān ghorān na muṃcaṃtam mahābalam
na kārmukam vikarṣantam rāmam paśyāmi saṃyuge |
verses.translation: "It has become imperceivable for me to me to see when and how he drew his ghastly arrows from quiver on the battleground; or, stretching his bow admitting those arrows on bowstring - no; or, his releasing those sharp edged arrows from the bow - no; why them, that great mighty Rama himself has become imperceptible in the fastness of his action.

glosses.meaning: shooting from bowstring, [arrows with sharp points]

verses.devanagari:
हन्यमानम् तु तत् सैन्यम् पश्यामि शर वृष्टिभिः
इन्द्रेण इव उत्तमम् सस्यम् आहतम् तु अश्म वृष्टिभिः |
verses.iast:
hanyamānam tu tat sainyam paśyāmi śara vṛṣṭibhiḥ
indreṇa iva uttamam sasyam āhatam tu aśma vṛṣṭibhiḥ |
verses.translation: "As with a crop of grain devastated by a hailstorm of Indra, I could only see that best army while it is being annihilated with a downpour of arrows.

glosses.meaning: with stones, of rain - with hailstorm
I am seeing - then I have seen.

verses.devanagari:
रक्षसाम् भीम वीर्याणाम् सहस्राणि चतुर्दश
निहतानि शरैः तीक्ष्णैः तेन एकेन पदातिना |
अर्धाधिक मुहूर्तेन खरः च सह दूषणः
verses.iast:
rakṣasām bhīma vīryāṇām sahasrāṇi caturdaśa
nihatāni śaraiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ tena ekena padātinā |
ardhādhika muhūrtena kharaḥ ca saha dūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "Thus a lone foot-soldier with his excruciating arrows has exterminated fourteen thousand demons with fiendish might, including Duushana, and along withKhara, say, within one and half hours.
notes: The above is consolidated and said as: saH ayam adhunaa muni jana samucita veShopi dhik kR^ita shakra paraakrame vikrameNa shakra kaarmuka sadR^ikSham caapam aakR^iShya mahaa viShaan aashii viShaan iva rukma punkhaan anukShaNam prakShipan rakSho vikShobhakaram ati bhayankaram ruupam aavahati - dk.

glosses.meaning: foot-soldier, lone one, by him [by Rama]
along with, Duushana, Khara, is also [killed.]

verses.devanagari:
ऋषीणाम् अभयम् दत्तम् कृत क्षेमाः च दण्डकाः
एका कथंचित् मुक्ता अहम् परिभूय महात्मना |
स्त्री वधम् शंकमानेन रामेण विदितात्मना
verses.iast:
ṛṣīṇām abhayam dattam kṛta kṣemāḥ ca daṇḍakāḥ
ekā kathañcit muktā aham paribhūya mahātmanā |
strī vadham śaṃkamānena rāmeṇa viditātmanā
verses.translation: "Accorded is the protection to the sages, and Dandaka is made as a snuggest place for them. I am the lone one somehow let off by such a high-minded Rama, of course, on humiliating me by cutting my nose and ears. Maybe, it is because he is hesitant of woman-slaughter for he is a well-versed soul.
notes: Here she twisted the story line to her side, as she edited the scene of her humiliation later to annihilation of their army. In Dandaka witch-hunting is over and it is calm and collected now. In fact, Ravana intruded into Janasthaana of Dandaka and stationed some army to protect intrusion into Lanka, as his mainstay is only the castled city Lanka. Now that the doors to Lanka are wide open Lanka is exposed to an imminent danger. nishaacaraan asankhyaiH rukma punkhaiH vishikhaiH vimadhya shatamakha mukhamakha bhuje akhila tapasvinaH ca nirbhayam vidhaaya danDakaaraNyam api sakala muni jana sharaNyam atanuta - dk .

glosses.itrans: - one foot verse, 12. R^iSiiNaam abhayam dattam
glosses.iast: - one foot verse, 12. ṛṣīṇām abhayam dattam
glosses.devanagari: ओने fओओत् वेर्से, 12. ऋषीणां अभयं दत्तं

glosses.meaning: made [restored,] to safety - rendered as snuggest place, also
by high-minded one, well-versed, soul - in scriptures

verses.devanagari:
भ्राता च अस्य महातेजा गुणतः तुल्य विक्रमः |
अनुरक्तः च भक्तः च लक्ष्मणो नाम वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
bhrātā ca asya mahātejā guṇataḥ tulya vikramaḥ |
anuraktaḥ ca bhaktaḥ ca lakṣmaṇo nāma vīryavān
verses.translation: "A highly resplendent one who by his trait matches his brother in bravery, an adherent and a devotee of his brother, such a stout-hearted one is Rama's brother known as Lakshmana.

glosses.meaning: by trait, matches [his brother Rama,] in bravery

verses.devanagari:
अमर्षी दुर्जयो जेता विक्रान्तो बुद्धिमान् बली |
रामस्य दक्षिणे बाहुः नित्यम् प्राणो बहिः चरः
verses.iast:
amarṣī durjayo jetā vikrānto buddhimān balī |
rāmasya dakṣiṇe bāhuḥ nityam prāṇo bahiḥ caraḥ
verses.translation: "That Lakshmana is an easily irritable one, he is not that easily invincible, an easy victor, but not an easygoing valiant, yet he is an intellectual at ease, and a mighty one who does not ease off, such a Lakshmana is the perpetual right-hand and the peripherally moving life of Rama.

verses.devanagari:
रामस्य तु विशालाक्षी पूर्णेन्दु सदृश आनना |
धर्म पत्नी प्रिया नित्यम् भर्तृः प्रिय हिते रता
verses.iast:
rāmasya tu viśālākṣī pūrṇendu sadṛśa ānanā |
dharma patnī priyā nityam bhartṛḥ priya hite ratā
verses.translation: "But, one with her broad-eyes, face similar to the full-moon is the dear and wedded wife of Rama, and she always takes delight in the well-being of her dear one, namely Rama.

glosses.meaning: full, moon, similar, one with such face
always, in her dear one - Rama's, well-being, delights in.

verses.devanagari:
सा सुकेशी सुनासोरुः सुरूपा च यशस्विनी |
देवत इव वनस्थ अस्यराजते श्रीर् इव अपरा
verses.iast:
sā sukeśī sunāsoruḥ surūpā ca yaśasvinī |
devata iva vanastha asyarājate śrīr iva aparā
verses.translation: "She is the one with lengthy hairdo, her nose and thighs are fine, and that glorious one with fine looks is the wife of Rama, and she is beaming forth like a sylvan deity situated in that woodland, who in turn is like Goddess Lakshmi in a temporal form.

glosses.meaning: of that, situated in woodland, goddess, like

verses.devanagari:
तप्त कांचन वर्ण आभा रक्त तुंग नखी शुभा |
सीता नाम वरारोहा वैदेही तनु मध्यमा
verses.iast:
tapta kāṃcana varṇa ābhā rakta tuṃga nakhī śubhā |
sītā nāma varārohā vaidehī tanu madhyamā
verses.translation: "She has a complexion mathing the shade of refined gold, her nails are rosy and jutting, and she with her curvaceous hips and slim waist is the daughter of King of Videha, and known as Seetha.

glosses.meaning: burnt [refined,] gold, in colour [in complexion,] in shade of
that daughter of king of Videha kingdom

verses.devanagari:
न एव देवी न गंधर्वा न यक्षी न च किंनरी |
तथा रूपा मया नारी दृष्ट पूर्वा महीतले
verses.iast:
na eva devī na gaṃdharvā na yakṣī na ca kiṃnarī |
tathā rūpā mayā nārī dṛṣṭa pūrvā mahītale
verses.translation: "So far I have not seen any goddess with such a comeliness; a gandharva female - no; a yaksha female - no; a kinnara female - no; and a woman, no, not on the face of earth!

glosses.meaning: by me, not, in that way, seen, previously - so far
woman, on the face of earth

verses.devanagari:
यस्य सीता भवेत् भार्या यम् च हृष्टा परिष्वजेत् |
अति जीवेत् स सर्वेषु लोकेषु अपि पुरंदरात्
verses.iast:
yasya sītā bhavet bhāryā yam ca hṛṣṭā pariṣvajet |
ati jīvet sa sarveṣu lokeṣu api puraṃdarāt
verses.translation: "To whom Seetha becomes a wife and around whom she gladly throws her arms after such a marriage, he lives more grandly than Indra in all the worlds.

glosses.meaning: gladly, whom, she hugs, also [after becoming his wife - not owing to a forced marriage]

verses.devanagari:
सा सुशीला वपुः श्लाघ्या रूपेण अप्रतिमा भुवि |
तव अनुरूपा भार्या सा त्वम् च तस्याः पतिः वरः
verses.iast:
sā suśīlā vapuḥ ślāghyā rūpeṇa apratimā bhuvi |
tava anurūpā bhāryā sā tvam ca tasyāḥ patiḥ varaḥ
verses.translation: "She is a highly gracious lady, laudable by her bodily structure, incomparable by her appearance, and she will become a seemly wife of yours, and you too will become a best husband of hers.

glosses.meaning: she is, to you, seemly for, a wife

verses.devanagari:
ताम् तु विस्तीर्ण जघनाम् पीन उत्तुंग पयो धराम् |
भार्या अर्थे तु तव आनेतुम् उद्यता अहम् वर आननाम्
विरूपिता अस्मि क्रूरेण लक्ष्मणेन महाभुज
verses.iast:
tām tu vistīrṇa jaghanām pīna uttuṃga payo dharām |
bhāryā arthe tu tava ānetum udyatā aham vara ānanām
virūpitā asmi krūreṇa lakśmaṇena mahābhuja
verses.translation: "Oh, mighty shouldered brother, but when I ventured to bring her as your wife, whose hips are broad, bosom fat and bulgy, face excellent, that cruel Lakshmana disfigured me.

glosses.meaning: one with fatty, bulgy, milk, containers [breasts]
her, who has excellent, face, but
wife, for the purpose of, but

verses.devanagari:
ताम् तु दृष्ट्वा अद्य वैदेहीम् पूर्ण चन्द्र निभ आननाम्
मन्मथस्य शराणाम् च त्वम् विधेयो भविष्यसि |
verses.iast:
tām tu dṛṣṭvā adya vaidehīm pūrṇa candra nibha ānanām
manmathasya śarāṇām ca tvam vidheyo bhaviṣyasi |
verses.translation: "You too will become a groveller at the arrows Lover-god in case you now see Vaidehi with a face shining like full-moon.

glosses.meaning: full, moon, shine, with such a face
her, at Vaidehi, now, if you see

verses.devanagari:
यदि तस्याम् अभिप्रायो भार्या अर्थे तव जायते |
शीघ्रम् उद् ध्रियताम् पादो जयार्थम् इह दक्षिणः
verses.iast:
yadi tasyām abhiprāyo bhāryā arthe tava jāyate |
śīghram ud.h dhriyatām pādo jayārtham iha dakṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: "Hence, if you hatch an opinion to make her as your wife, and if you aspire success, now itself quickly put your best foot, namely your right foot, forward.

glosses.meaning: your, wife, for the purpose of
opinion, is created, if - if you hatch
success, for the purpose of - if you aspire success
quickly, be upraised - put your best foot forward.

verses.devanagari:
रोचते यदि ते वाक्यम् मम एतत् राक्षसेश्वर |
क्रियताम् निर्विशंकेन वचनम् मम रावण
verses.iast:
rocate yadi te vākyam mama etat rākśaseśvara |
kriyatām nir.hviśaṃkena vacanam mama rāvaṇa
verses.translation: "Oh, the king of demons Ravana, if this advise of mine is pleasing to you, let this idea be actualised without any shilly-shallying in your mind.

glosses.meaning: without, verily, doubting - without becoming a shilly-shallyer
my, sentence - idea, let it be done.

verses.devanagari:
विज्ञाय इह आत्म शक्तिम् च क्रियताम् च महाबल |
सीता तव अनवद्यांगी भार्यत्वे राक्षसेश्वर
verses.iast:
vijñāya iha ātma śaktim ca kriyatām ca mahābala |
sītā tava anavadyāṃgī bhāryatve rākśaseśvara
verses.translation: "Oh, king of the demons, realise your stout-heartedness, and oh, great mighty one, let that immaculately limbed Seetha be abducted to become your wife.

glosses.meaning: your own, capacity - stout-heartedness, on realizing, an a vadya angii = not, un, speakable, limbed - one with immaculate limbs
Seetha, for your, in wifehood - to become a wife

verses.devanagari:
निशम्य रामेण शरैः अजिह्मगैः
हतान् जनस्थान गतान् निशाचरान् |
खरम् च दृष्ट्वा निहतम् च दूषणम्
त्वम् अद्य कृत्यम् प्रतिपत्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
niśamya rāmeṇa śaraiḥ ajihmagaiḥ
hatān janasthāna gatān niśācarān |
kharam ca dṛṣṭvā nihatam ca dūṣaṇam
tvam adya kṛtyam pratipattum arhasi
verses.translation: "On recognising that Rama with his straight shooting arrows destroyed the night-walkers positioned at Janasthaana, and further on distinguishing that Duushana, and even Khara, is dispatched, it is apt of you to awake to a workable action." Thus Shuurpanakha has earbashed Ravana.

glosses.meaning: killed, on seeing - be conscious of
you, now, action that is to be taken - doable deed, accomplishable
to awake to, apt of you.
